'''Kpati''' is an [[language death|extinct]] [[Grassfields language]] formerly spoken in the [[Wukari]] and [[Takum]] LGAs of [[Taraba State]], [[Nigeria]].<ref name=e25/> It was first reported as extinct by Grimes, Barbara (1984).<ref name=":0">{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=iKHOeLDvUVgC&q=kpati&pg=PA301|title=Language Death: Factual and Theoretical Explorations with Special Reference to East Africa|last=Brenzinger|first=Matthias|date=1992|publisher=Walter de Gruyter|isbn=9783110134049|pages=363|language=en}}</ref><ref>Grimes, Barbara. "Languages of the world" (1984), p. 235</ref> Kpati was classified as a [[Ngemba language]] by Fivas – Scott (1977).<ref name=":0" />
